title: Meet the king
objectives: Understand the king moves one square in any direction

steps.text: The king moves just one square in any direction — straight or diagonal. He's the piece you must always protect.

steps.prompt: Move the king exactly one square in any direction.

hints.text: Move the king exactly one square, any direction.
Any of the eight neighboring squares works.
The king steps from e4 to e5.

feedback.default: The king can only move one square at a time — not further.
